title: CueMirror — a simple, fast teleprompter for iPhone and Android
description: A simple, fast teleprompter for video, live streams and presentations. Write or paste your script, press play and look at the camera, or record yourself in the app. No account, no cloud, no watermark.
ogImageAlt: CueMirror logo with the line: Speak with confidence.
subtitle: A simple, fast teleprompter for video, live streams and presentations. Look at the camera, not at your notes, and record the take right in the app.
badge: No account. No cloud. No watermark.
storesSoon: Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play
demoLabel: Demo: a script scrolling on the CueMirror teleprompter, with the reading line fixed in the middle of the screen.
demoScript: Hi, everyone. Thanks for being here.
Today I want to show you something simple.
Write your script, press play and keep your eyes on the camera.
The words come to you, at your own pace.
If you need a second, pause. Then pick up where you left off.
One thought at a time. One clear take.

steps.title: Write or paste
steps.text: Type your script in the app, paste it from anywhere, or dictate it with your keyboard's microphone.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.text: Set the speed, text size, margins and colors to match the way you read.

steps.title: Read to the camera
steps.text: Press play, wait for the countdown and read with your eyes near the lens. Adjust as you go, or record the take right in the app.

features.title: Record while you read
features.text: Film yourself with the front camera while the script scrolls at the top of the screen, close to the lens. Watch the take, then save it to your gallery or share it.

features.title: Hands-free with Bluetooth
features.text: With a Bluetooth keyboard or pedal: press to play or pause, hold to go back to the start.

features.title: Ready for teleprompter glass
features.text: Mirrored and Flipped modes for rigs with a glass, so the text reads the right way in the reflection.

features.title: Bring your script
features.text: Import .txt, .docx and .pdf files, including from Google Docs, and export any script as .txt.

privacyText: No account and no cloud: the app never sends your scripts or videos anywhere.

faq.a: Yes. The free version has no time limit and no watermark. Premium is optional, with a monthly or annual subscription; the store shows the price in your local currency.

faq.q: Do I need an account or an internet connection?
faq.a: No account is needed, and there is no cloud: your scripts are stored on your device, and writing and reading work without an internet connection. Only subscribing or restoring your subscription needs a connection.
Yes, with Premium. Film yourself with the front camera while the script scrolls at the top of the screen, then save the take to your gallery or share it.

faq.q: Does it work with a Bluetooth pedal or keyboard?
faq.a: Yes, with Premium: press to play or pause, hold to go back to the start.

faq.q: Does it work with teleprompter glass?
faq.a: Yes. Premium has Mirrored and Flipped modes, so the text reads the right way in the reflection.
With Premium you can import .txt, .docx and .pdf files and export scripts as .txt. In the free version you can paste your script or dictate it with your keyboard's microphone.

faq.q: Can I use it over other apps?
faq.a: Only on Android: Premium includes a floating window that stays over other apps.

faq.q: Do my scripts leave my device?
faq.a: The app never sends your scripts or videos to us or to any server. Your system's own backup (Google or iCloud) may include your scripts, in your account.

supportTitle: Questions, ideas or something not working?
supportText: Write to us. Suggestions are welcome too. If something isn't working, tell us your device model and the app version.
